correctness.rationale: Candidate intervals are disjoint for f>=8; distinct-pair interval sumsets reduce greedy membership to exact cover/disjointness. The 57-component, 1640-sum affine interval verifier compares endpoint slopes and shifted intercepts: no crossings after f=14, and checks f=8..15; this is a legitimate all-f certificate, not finite extrapolation. Four repeated nonempty 3M-blocks from the certified prefix invoke van Berkel--Bosma Theorem 15 to extend indefinitely. A distinct-gap-size argument rules out a shorter tail period, and the last transient gap proves exact preperiod. Independently computed 250 greedy terms for each f=8..19. Reliance on the published four-block theorem was checked for stated hypotheses in RESULT.md, but the primary paper theorem proof was not available in full this run.
